scope: Only complete, single-speaker audio from the watched other-VTuber video may be omitted. Text, timings, title, cover, and all non-omitted cues are frozen.

local_visual_windows.fact: Watched-video layout is active; the inner screen is black while the host layout remains visible.
Inner watched video visibly plays animated footage with its own on-picture captions.
Inner watched video remains visible while the source subtitle layer is separately present.

audio_source_basis: The retained speaker-final analysis has a single guest cluster for the complete-IN_VIDEO cue set. This receipt does not elevate its labels alone: the labels are used only where the local visual playback window is active and no host-labelled subwindow occurs.

exhaustive_projection.drop_rule: For source indexes 1..66 in ascending order: omit exactly complete_in_video_source_cues; otherwise retain source cue byte-for-byte and assign reviewed index one plus the number of retained earlier source indexes.

mixed_cue_policy: No sub-cue edit is emitted. Cues 5, 47, 48, 49, and 52 have mixed host/guest windows; cues 35 and 44 are brief guest-labelled interjections without a reliable source split. They remain frozen rather than being whole-cue drops.
